item.text:
**Verdict**  
Mixed, leaning negative. AMLO showed occasional candor on politically costly matters, especially election outcomes and a few domestic abuses, but 2024 also shows repeated hostile messaging, self-serving public framing, and at least one externally documented false-claims episode. I do not see a habit of telling the truth across audiences; I do see selective truth-telling when denial would have been harder to sustain.

**Accepted Claims**
- **Court order for right of reply to AMLO’s false claims** — Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, 2024-06-17 — https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico  
  Summary: Reuters Institute says Xochitl Gálvez obtained a court-ordered right of reply to AMLO’s false claims. This is direct evidence against habitual truthfulness.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **Public doxxing-style attack on a New York Times reporter** — Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, 2024-06-17 — https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico  
  Summary: The same overview says AMLO publicly displayed a reporter’s personal phone number on broadcast, with YouTube removing the video under anti-harassment rules. That is not a lie by itself, but it is consistent with a pattern of manipulative, intimidatory communication rather than straightforward truth-telling.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **Frequent verbal attacks on journalists, rights advocates, and the media** — Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, 2024-06-17 — https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico  
  Summary: Reuters Institute describes AMLO’s final year as marked by repeated attacks on critics and the press. This supports the view that he often used the public sphere to pressure or discredit scrutiny instead of being consistently truthful.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **INE overhaul framed as power consolidation** — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-06-04 — https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906  
  Summary: Reuters reported AMLO frequently lambasted the INE and sought an overhaul that critics saw as a way to cement Morena’s hegemony and weaken contestable power. That is indirect evidence of deceptive or at least strategically misleading framing when institutional checks were at stake.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **Judicial overhaul weakened independent constraints** — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-15 — https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588  
  Summary: Reuters reported the overhaul weakened judicial independence. On a truthfulness lens, this matters because the administration publicly sold the reform as citizen-serving while critics said it concentrated power.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **Rosy Sixth Report was a self-portrait, not independent validation** — Presidencia de México, 2024-09-01 — https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/200-puntos-del-sexto-informe-de-gobierno/  
  Summary: AMLO’s end-of-term report claimed gains in poverty, inflation, debt, investment, and public programs. This is official self-reporting; by itself it does not prove falsehood, but it is a self-serving presentation that should be treated cautiously.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **IMF undercut the rosy macro narrative** — IMF, 2024-10-15 — https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/15/mcs-mexico-staff-concluding-statement-of-the-2024-aiv-mission  
  Summary: The IMF said inflation pressures were receding and frameworks were strong, but also warned about procyclical fiscal policy, a widening deficit, and the need for medium-term consolidation. This does not prove lying, but it does show the government’s upbeat public narrative was selective.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **Extortion still far above AMLO’s starting point** — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-01-25 — https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/rampant-extortion-reveals-corrosive-hole-in-mexico-security-strategy-3283251  
  Summary: Reuters reported extortion remained far above the level when AMLO took office. That undercuts any overly optimistic public framing on security and suggests he was not consistently candid about the lived security environment.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **Orderly election result presentation** — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-05 — https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presentan-resultados-de-elecciones-en-conferencia-del-presidente-se-requiere-garantizar-el-derecho-a-la-informacion-afirma/  
  Summary: AMLO publicly presented the preliminary presidential results and framed the moment around public access to information rather than denial or destabilization. This is positive evidence that he could tell the truth when the election outcome cut against personal power.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **Respect the electoral authority’s decision** — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-20 — https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/20-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/  
  Summary: AMLO said a vote-by-vote recount was the best way to remove suspicion and that one should respect what the electoral authority decides. This supports limited candor in a politically sensitive setting.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **No reelection and orderly handoff** — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-25 and 2024-08-13 — https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/25-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/ ; https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/tribunal-electoral-valida-eleccion-presidencial-segob-presidente-celebra-ejemplar-transicion-en-gobierno-federal/  
  Summary: AMLO said he would not seek reelection and later celebrated an orderly, constitutional transition to Sheinbaum. This is positive evidence of truthfulness about personal departure from power.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **Admitted police repression in Veracruz** — El Economista, 2024-07-16 — https://www.eleconomista.com.mx/politica/AMLO-acepta-represion-violenta-en-Veracruz-informa-que-hay-dos-detenidos-20240716-0024.html  
  Summary: AMLO said police used violence against protesters, said they should not have acted that way, and said two officers were detained. This is one of the clearest 2024 examples of acknowledging state misconduct rather than denying it.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

- **Ceasefire call on Middle East war** — Presidencia de México, 2024-04-15 — https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/apoyemos-la-paz-y-la-fraternidad-universal-presidente-llama-al-cese-al-fuego-en-medio-oriente/  
  Summary: AMLO called for a ceasefire, dialogue, and an agreement to stop the war. This is positive evidence of straightforward de-escalatory public messaging.  
  IDs: `7B.1`

**Search gap**
- I found clearer evidence for truthfulness to the public than to legislatures, courts, allies, or international partners.
- Direct transcript-level evidence about what AMLO told legislators or foreign counterparts in 2024 is limited in the material I found; most of the strongest evidence is about public messaging, media treatment, and contested public claims.
- The negative case is stronger on pattern than on a single definitive lie: repeated hostility to scrutiny, selective self-reporting, and at least one documented false-claims episode.
